description:
Three classic papers in your library have a metadata error: the primary authors were imported as 'Single Field' names (like organizations) rather than 'Two Field' names (Person). This causes citations to format incorrectly (e.g., 'Turing, Alan' instead of 'Turing, A.').

Your task is to fix the author formatting for these three papers:
1. 'A Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Author: Shannon, Claude E.)
2. 'Computing Machinery and Intelligence' (Author: Turing, Alan)
3. 'A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes' (Author: Huffman, David A.)

For each paper:
- Select the paper in the library.
- In the Info pane on the right, locate the author field.
- Click the small 'Switch to two fields' icon (looks like two small bars) next to the name.
- Ensure the name is correctly split into Last Name and First Name fields.

The goal is to have all three authors stored as People (two fields) rather than Single Field.

targets.title: A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes
